labelRules: Owner confirms materials independently of the photo matcher.
A magnetic band or velvet depth is a cue, not proof; distinguish ordinary reflection and glitter with hard negative photos.
Do not infer hidden fingers, double one hand, or fabricate nail/part boxes.
Quantity needs visible per-nail evidence or owner confirmation.
Removal, repair need and customer membership remain explicit inputs.
datasetExport: Settings: confirmed photos and quotes export; compressed photo, SHA-256, owner-confirmed item quantities, baseline snapshot, timestamp; local only.

modelCandidates.name: SigLIP2
modelCandidates.role: Evaluate material similarity/embedding on confirmed cropped nails; not a counter.
